Maya: Heads up 026-04 pricing test created an invoice for Acadia Labs that auto-posted to revenue instead of deferred. INV-2026-4021 for $12,000 dated 2026-04-10. Need to move to deferred revenue and amortize over the pilot period. Can we fix in April close?
Eli: Can you confirm the pilot term / amortization days and which GL it hit?
Maya: Pilot runs 2026-04-10 -> 2026-07-07 (89 days). System posted to GL 4100 (Services Revenue).
Rohan: Quick calc: 12,000 / 89 = 134.83146 -> $134.83 per day.
Maya: We recognized revenue through Apr 14 (5 days) so PTD recognized = $674.15.
Priya: Proposed NetSuite JEs: 
1) Reclass to deferral (effective 4/10/2026):
   Debit Revenue (4100)       $12,000.00
   Credit Deferred Revenue (2150) $12,000.00

2) Recognize PTD (Apr 10-14) at April close (JE date 2026-04-30):
   Debit Deferred Revenue (2150)   $674.15
   Credit Revenue (4100)           $674.15

Note: rounding residual to 4790 per policy. Include memo referencing INV-2026-4021 and attach SOW.
Eli: ok from me. Need RevOps approval to post in close.
RevOpsBot: Approval requested: reclass + PTD recognition for INV-2026-4021.
Priya: RevOps 0shana can you sign off?
Rohan: Also flag subscription revenue schedule update so deferred totals match AR ledger.
Maya: I'll attach invoice PDF + SOW to JE and update the revenue schedule entry.
BillingBot: Payment recorded: INV-2026-4021 paid $12,000.00 on 2026-04-10.
RevOpsBot: Approved by @Oshana. Please post both JEs during April close window.
Priya: Posted reversal JE #JE-2026-0820 (Debit Rev / Credit Deferral) and recognition JE #JE-2026-0821 for PTD. Left rounding variance $0.05 to 4790 per rounding guideline.
Maya: Added one-line note on April close checklist and linked docs in the RevRec board. Notifying CS to add internal note for Acadia.
Eli: Thanks all 0:thumbsup:
Maya: Closing thread.
